outcome.answer: Measure performance on held-out cases that require applying the rules or knowledge in the provided text, rather than merely reproducing it. RuleWorld evaluates single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning scenarios, providing a benchmark for externally supplied procedural rules [2]. For a controlled test of learning a genuinely unseen rule, the cellular-automaton study withholds one truth-table entry and tests whether the model can infer it where similarity-based interpolation fails [3]. Compare rule descriptions with input-output examples to assess whether performance depends on how the task is presented [1].
